entries.task_id: the heaven|is|opened and will become gateways
entries.description: the heaven is opened and will become gateways
entries.subject: the heaven

spans.text: [19] AR: وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَٰبًۭا EN: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways
[28] AR: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كِذَّابًۭا EN: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.

entries.description: things We have enumerated in writing
entries.subject: things We

spans.text: [29] AR: وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ كِتَٰبًۭا EN: But all things We have enumerated in writing.
[31] AR: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا EN: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -

[37] AR: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًۭا EN: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful.

[38] AR: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّۭا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًۭا EN: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.
[39] AR: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا EN: That is the True Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.

spans.text: [40] AR: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَٰكُمْ عَذَابًۭا قَرِيبًۭا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا EN: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
[8] AR: وَخَلَقْنَٰكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا EN: And We created you in pairs
